summary.text: Robert W. Nutting, a Republican, represents House District 66 (Mercer, Oakland, Sidney, Smithfield and Starks) in the Maine House of Representatives, and lives in Oakland. The House profile lists service as Ranking Member of the Criminal Justice and Public Safety Committee and membership on the Ethics Committee.

paragraphs.text: The Maine House profile lists legislative service in the House during the 119th, 120th, 121st, 122nd, 124th, 125th, 126th, 127th, 131st and 132nd Legislatures.
The profile gives retired pharmacist as the occupation and a B.S. (1970) as the degree.
Listed affiliations are the Oakland Town Council and the Lions Club.
It says Nutting is married, to Wendy, with three children and five grandchildren.
